The '''Sanctuary research complex''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It was known to have housed the lab of famous [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] scientist [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] and the cage of a huge [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], called [[Grim Tooth]].
